item.title: How the World Cup Is Impacting the North American Touring Market
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's podcast, where we're talking about the impact of the FIFA World Cup on the music scene. The 2026 World Cup is just around the corner, and it's not just soccer fans who are taking notice. The tournament is set to affect the concert schedule for many stadiums across North America. Let's dive in and explore how this is shaping up to be one of the biggest stadium tour summers ever."
[Music transitions to a brief clip]
Host: "The U.S. is hosting the World Cup for the second time, and this year, many stadiums in major markets like Toronto, Mexico City, Atlanta, and Los Angeles will be going dark from 20 days before the first games until the end of the tournament on July 19. This means no concerts for two months during prime outdoor concert season."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "However, despite initial concerns, this summer is turning out to be a massive stadium tour season. Artists like Bruno Mars, Karol G, Noah Kahan, Morgan Wallen, and Ed Sheeran are all set to perform in stadiums across North America. Some artists are getting creative with their tour routes, starting in Europe or avoiding cities with World Cup games until later in the summer."
[Music transitions to a brief clip]
Host: "For example, Ed Sheeran is kicking off his North American tour in cities that aren't hosting World Cup games, like Nashville, Chicago, and Denver. He'll make his way to Levi's Stadium near San Francisco just six days after the World Cup ends. Meanwhile, Bruno Mars has already completed his North American dates in cities like Atlanta, Nashville, and Toronto, and will now head to Europe before returning to the U.S. in August."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "It's clear that the World Cup is having a significant impact on the concert schedule, but it's also leading to some exciting and creative tour routing. We'll be keeping an eye on how this plays out and bringing you updates on the latest stadium tours. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time!"
[Outro music plays]
